tex_content.html:
\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Uniform curvature bound on an extended backward time interval] ↗ cor:curvature-bound-near-basepoint

For each $A<\infty $, eventually there are $\delta >0$, $\delta \le T_0-T$, and a bound independent of $n$ for the scalar curvature of $B_{Q_nG_n}(x_n,0,A)\times [-(T+\delta ),0]$. \end{claim}
Proof

↗ lem:curvature-control-canonical-nbhd ↗ cor:curvature-bound-near-basepoint \sketch Apply Corollary 2 on the $2A$-ball and Lemma 5; then use narrows, Hamilton’s compactness theorem, and Harnack to extend the limit and bound its curvature.

□
